tests: Distinguishing cluster, spread, and partition placement groups by hardware failure isolation.
expected: Partition placement group — partitions on separate racks, a hardware failure affects one partition. Triggers: "HDFS / Cassandra / Kafka", "don't lose more than one replica group", "grouped placement".
why_not: Cluster puts everything on one rack (shared failure domain); spread allows max 7 instances per AZ, too few for large clusters; no placement group gives no isolation guarantees.
